definition_en: The ability to adapt to changing circumstances, recover from setbacks, and adjust approaches in response to new challenges, uncertainty, or stress.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk menyesuaikan diri dengan perubahan, bangkit semula daripada kegagalan, dan menyesuaikan pendekatan apabila menghadapi cabaran, ketidakpastian atau tekanan.
typical_tasks_en:
• Switch to a backup vendor within 24 hours after the main supplier missed the deadline.
• Continue serving customers calmly during a prolonged system outage and keep the team updated.
• Take on a colleague's client accounts when they went on emergency leave without handing over properly.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Bertukar kepada pembekal ganti dalam masa 24 jam selepas pembekal utama gagal menghantar.
• Terus berkhidmat kepada pelanggan dengan tenang semasa gangguan sistem berpanjangan dan pastikan pasukan dimaklumkan.
• Ambil alih akaun pelanggan rakan sekerja apabila mereka bercuti kecemasan tanpa menyerahkan tugas dengan betul.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires adapting to unexpected changes or disruptions
• The task involves working under uncertainty or ambiguity
• The task requires recovering from failures or setbacks
• The task demands switching between different priorities or methods
• The task involves working in volatile or high-pressure environments
exclusion_rules:
• The task follows a completely predictable and stable routine
• The user only executes tasks with clear, unchanging instructions
• The task involves no exposure to change, pressure, or uncertainty
• The user is performing work in a fully controlled environment
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task says work is busy or challenging without describing actual change, pressure, or recovery.

confusions.boundary_rule: Resilience is about adapting to external change and recovering. Motivation is about internal drive and self-understanding.
confusions.example_task: Reflect on my stress response after a difficult week and set a self-care goal.

confusions.boundary_rule: Resilience requires adapting under pressure. Dependability is about consistent, accurate execution regardless of pressure.
confusions.example_task: Keep producing accurate reports despite last-minute requirement changes.
confusions.expected_labels: Resilience, flexibility and agility; Dependability and attention to detail

confusions.boundary_rule: Resilience is personal adaptation. Leadership involves guiding and influencing others through change.
confusions.example_task: Reorganise the team's priorities after a key member resigns.
confusions.expected_labels: Leadership and social influence; Resilience, flexibility and agility
